plugins.name: Fangcun quota feed
plugins.description: Read-only quota feed for Fangcun (方寸): Codex and Antigravity accounts' plan, status and quota windows, behind a feed token of its own. Adds a panel with a connection string to paste into Fangcun.
plugins.author: Sakuralaaa

zh-CN.name: 方寸额度只读接口
zh-CN.description: 给方寸用的只读额度接口：读取 Codex 和 Antigravity 账号的套餐、状态和各额度窗口，用插件自己的只读令牌访问。管理面板里有「方寸」页面，复制连接串粘贴到方寸即可。
